title: Blockchain-Enabled Secure Logging for Fiscal Electronic Mechanisms: Evaluation of the Greek eSEND and myDATA Tax Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.04356v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper analyzes the implementation of blockchain-based integrity mechanisms in Greek Fiscal Electronic Mechanisms (FEMs) and the central tax information system eSEND. The study examines the cryptographic architecture of fiscal devices, including Electronic Cash Registers, Fiscal Printers, Fiscal Signing Machines, and FEMAS devices, which implement double or triple hash-chain structures to ensure transaction immutability. The transmission protocol between fiscal devices and the central database is also evaluated with respect to encryption, sequential validation, and blockchain verification. In contrast, the architecture of Electronic Invoicing Provider Services and the myDATA central platform is analyzed, highlighting the absence of blockchain-based integrity guarantees. translated_title: 基于区块链的财政电子机制安全日志记录：希腊eSEND与myDATA税务系统评估
translated_abstract: 本文分析了基于区块链的完整性机制在希腊财政电子机制（FEMs）和中央税务信息系统eSEND中的实施情况。该研究考察了财政设备的密码学架构，包括电子收银机、财政打印机、财政签名机和FEMAS设备，这些设备实现了双重或三重哈希链结构以确保交易的不可篡改性。研究还从加密、顺序验证和区块链验证等方面评估了财政设备与中央数据库之间的传输协议。相比之下，本文分析了电子发票服务商服务和myDATA中央平台的架构，指出了其缺乏基于区块链的完整性保证。比较研究表明，基于硬件的财政机制为交易完整性和防篡改性提供了比纯软件方案更强的保障。
tldr: 本文评估了希腊eSEND和myDATA税务系统，发现基于硬件的财政电子机制通过双重/三重哈希链和区块链验证为交易完整性提供了比纯软件方案更强的防篡改保障。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates the Greek eSEND and myDATA tax systems, finding that hardware-based fiscal electronic mechanisms, through double/triple hash-chains and blockchain verification, provide stronger tamper-resistance and transaction completeness guarantees than purely software-based solutions.
